description.zh: 一台小型双足机器人，适合探索运动控制与机器人软件。
description.en: A small bipedal robot for exploring motion control and robotics software.

buildNotes.zh: 本站尚未核实完整材料清单与独立复现流程，请先阅读原作者资料。
buildNotes.en: A complete parts list and independent build process have not been verified here. Start with the author's documentation.

description.zh: 结合 3D 打印结构与控制软件的小型人形机器人。
description.en: A small humanoid robot combining 3D-printed mechanics and control software.

buildNotes.zh: 硬件许可含非商业限制；采购或衍生开发前请核对原仓库许可与材料清单。
buildNotes.en: The hardware license includes non-commercial restrictions. Check the source license and parts list before building or adapting it.

description.zh: 通过桌面机器人的动作，呈现 AI 编程助手的工作状态。
description.en: A desktop robot that expresses an AI coding assistant's status through movement.

buildNotes.zh: 原作者提供入门文档。采购前请以仓库当前版本的材料清单为准。
buildNotes.en: The author provides a getting-started guide. Check the current repository version before sourcing parts.

description.zh: 分体式机械键盘，提供不同版本的装配指南与零件清单。
description.en: A split mechanical keyboard with versioned build guides and parts lists.

buildNotes.zh: 零件数量和固件取决于所选版本；按对应版本的官方指南准备。
buildNotes.en: Parts and firmware depend on the revision; use the build guide for the chosen version.

description.zh: 基于 QMK 的机械数字小键盘，项目仓库包含 BOM 与装配指南。
description.en: A QMK mechanical numpad with a BOM and assembly guide in its repository.

buildNotes.zh: 完整用料请以项目仓库 BOM 为准。
buildNotes.en: Use the repository BOM for the complete list of parts.

description.zh: 以 ESP32 为基础的开放式智能手表，硬件与系统分仓维护。
description.en: An ESP32-based open smartwatch with separate hardware and OS repositories.

buildNotes.zh: 先选择硬件版本，再核对对应固件和装配资料。
buildNotes.en: Choose a hardware version first, then check the matching firmware and build documentation.

description.zh: 可自行搭建的空气质量监测设备，官方提供 DIY 指南。
description.en: A DIY air-quality monitor with an official build guide.

buildNotes.zh: 传感器与电路板版本会影响用料；按官方 DIY 页面核对。
buildNotes.en: Sensor and board revisions affect parts; check the official DIY page.

description.zh: 带屏幕的可编程宏键盘，支持自定义脚本与按键配置。
description.en: A programmable macropad with a display, custom scripts and key mappings.

buildNotes.zh: 先阅读项目仓库，确认硬件文件、版本与购买或自制路径。
buildNotes.en: Check the repository for hardware files, revision and purchase or DIY options.
